artigo.erro_obrigatorios: The reference and name are required.
artigo.erro_unidades_embalagem: How many units does each package hold? It must be greater than zero.
artigo.erro_conteudo: How much does each unit measure? It must be greater than zero.
artigo.erro_unidade_outra: Enter the base unit, or choose one from the list.
artigo.erro_preco: The price must be greater than zero.
artigo.erro_preco_nao_gravado: Item created, but the price was not saved. Publish it under “Prices”.
artigo.legenda_foto: Photograph the packaging — the name, brand and weight can usually be read from a single photo. The price is not read from the image.
artigo.ajuda_referencia: Your own code for this item. Unique within your storefront.
artigo.ajuda_imagem: The URL of an image already published somewhere — on your website, a social network or an image hosting service. It is the first thing the buyer sees in the storefront.
artigo.como_vende_ajuda: Buyers count in units — kilos, litres, pieces. A box of 12 bottles of 1 litre each holds 12 litres in total: give us both numbers and leave the calculation to us.
artigo.vende_unidade: Sold per unit — the price below is the price per {{unidade}}.
artigo.conversao_stock: Ten {{embalagens}} enter the buyer’s stock as {{quantidade}}.
artigo.quantas_em_stock: How many {{item}} you have in stock
artigo.ajuda_stock: Leave empty if you prefer not to publish it. Empty is not read as “out of stock” — the information is simply missing.
artigo.preco_ajuda: It is what the buyer sees first in a comparison. An item without a price is invisible in every comparison, even when published.
artigo.ajuda_preco_escaloes: You can publish different prices by quantity and change it later under “Prices”, in the item list.
artigo.ajuda_descricao: Helps people find the item when it has no barcode. Write it the way a buyer would search for it.

precos.ajuda_quantidade: 1 is the base price. A tier of 100 applies to orders of 100 or more, and does not replace the tier of 1.
precos.ajuda_vigor: It can be a future date — the price takes effect automatically on that day.
precos.aviso_3: — it does not delete it. The old one still answers “how much did it cost when the customer bought”, which is the question asked when checking an invoice.
precos.vazio: You have not published any price yet. Without a price, the item does not appear in any comparison.
precos.publicado: Price published. The previous one for this tier was closed, not deleted.
precos.erro_remover: Only prices that have not yet taken effect can be removed.
precos.erro_preco: The price must be greater than zero.
precos.erro_quantidade: The minimum quantity must be greater than zero.
precos.erro_datas: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.

vitrine.subtitulo: Publish once. Every buyer on the platform sees it.
vitrine.sem_preco_aviso_detalhe: An item without a price does not appear in any comparison, even when published.
vitrine.sem_gtin_ajuda_lista: Without a barcode, buyers find this item by name similarity — which fails when the name is not the one they use. With a GTIN, it is found with certainty.
vitrine.sem_gtin_ajuda_card: Without a barcode, buyers find this item by name similarity — which fails when the name is not the one they use.
vitrine.factor_ajuda: How many base units go into one selling unit. This is what prevents ten boxes from entering the buyer’s stock as ten units.
vitrine.erro_publicar_sem_preco: This item has no current price. Publish a price first — without one the item does not appear in any comparison.
vitrine.esgotado_ajuda: Marks it as out of stock. It stays visible — buyers can see it exists and will be back.

importar.erro_sem_resultado: No products could be read from this document. Try a sharper file, or check that it contains a product list.
importar.erro_analisar: The document could not be analysed.
importar.erro_sem_preco_one: {{count}} product has no price. Enter the price or untick that row before continuing.
importar.erro_sem_preco_other: {{count}} products have no price. Enter the prices or untick those rows before continuing.
importar.erro_importar: The import could not be completed.
importar.subtitulo: Upload a document with your product list — we read it and organise it for you.
importar.upload_intro: Upload your price list just as you already have it — a PDF, an Excel sheet, a Word document or even a photo of the pages. We read the products, prices and quantities, and you review everything before confirming.
importar.arraste: Drag and drop your file here
importar.formatos: PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), or a photo — up to {{mb}} MB
importar.tirar_foto: Take a photo of the price list
importar.recusadas_titulo_one: {{count}} line of the document was not read
importar.recusadas_titulo_other: {{count}} lines of the document were not read
importar.recusadas_acrescentar: . Add them manually later, using “New item”.
importar.adicionar_imagem: Add an image to this product
importar.concluido_sub: The new items were added as drafts — publish them on your storefront when you are ready.

perfil.subtitulo: Your organisation and your account. They can be different people — an organisation can have more than one portal account.
perfil.logo_ajuda: The URL of an image already published somewhere. It appears in the portal header and on the public marketplace profile.
perfil.nome_comercial_ajuda: If different. Shown in the header and on the public marketplace.
perfil.email_empresa_ajuda: The billing one — not the login one.
perfil.nuit_nota_depois: ) cannot be edited here — it is the key that prevents duplicate records of the same company. To correct a wrong NUIT, contact support.
perfil.login_nota_3: ) cannot be edited here. Changing the login email is a separate security operation.

registar.titulo: Register your company as a supplier
registar.subtitulo: Publish your catalogue once and be visible to every buyer on the platform. You do not pay to register.
registar.nome_comercial_ajuda: The name you are known by, if different.
registar.nuit_ajuda: This is how we avoid duplicate records of the same company. If your company was already registered by a customer, we find it and link your account to that record — with the full purchase history.
registar.administrar_nota: This account will manage the storefront. You can invite more people later.
registar.email_ajuda: You will receive the access code and password here. You can sign in with the email or the code.
registar.sem_senha_titulo: You do not choose a password here.
registar.sem_senha_texto: We send the access code and the initial password to the email address you enter above. Check that it is correct — it is how you get into the portal.
registar.email_responsavel_obrigatorio: The contact person's email is required — the access code is sent there.
registar.codigo_enviado_antes: We have sent this code and the
registar.codigo_enviado_depois: to the email address you gave. Check your inbox — and your junk folder if it is not there. You can sign in with the code or the email.
registar.reivindicacao_texto: It was already registered by one of your customers, and your account has been linked to that record — with the purchase history that already exists. Check the details in the portal.
registar.falta_isto: This is still needed before you can receive purchase orders:
registar.verificacao_nota: Documents are verified by the platform before your storefront enters the comparisons. In the meantime you can upload your items and prices — they are saved as drafts.

zonas.subtitulo: Where you deliver, how fast, and at what cost.
zonas.vazio_titulo: You have not declared any delivery zone
zonas.vazio_antes: Until then, your storefront is left out of
zonas.vazio_depois: comparisons — and it is a silent exclusion: you do not appear, and you receive no warning. The system cannot assume you deliver to a province you have not declared.
zonas.prevalece_ajuda: A city zone takes precedence over the province zone: shops in this city get these terms.
zonas.provincia_ajuda: Fixed list on purpose: a typing error here would make you disappear from that province's comparisons, with no warning.
zonas.cidade_ajuda: A city zone takes precedence over the province zone. Declare both if the terms are different in the capital.
zonas.dias_ajuda: Added to the item's dispatch lead time.
zonas.minimo_ajuda: Per delivery, not per item. A requisition whose share for you falls below this value is flagged to the buyer.
zonas.activa: Active zone — untick to suspend it temporarily without deleting it

documentos.subtitulo: Submit and the platform verifies. Self-approval is not possible — that is what gives the verification its value.
documentos.obrigatorios_ajuda: Without these, your storefront does not enter any comparison.
documentos.banco_depois: is also mandatory and cannot be submitted here: it needs approval by a second person. Talk to your contact at the platform.
documentos.recomendados_ajuda: They do not block purchasing. They improve your score in comparisons.
documentos.submetido: Document submitted. It is now awaiting verification by the platform.
documentos.descreva_outro: Describe the document when the type is “Other”.
documentos.validade_ajuda: Leave empty for documents with no expiry. With a date, we warn you before it expires.
documentos.endereco_ajuda: Uploading files directly is not available yet. For now, enter an address where the verifier can view the document.

layout.ver_editar_dados: View and edit the company and contact person details
layout.documentacao_completa: Documentation complete. Your storefront enters all comparisons.
layout.fora_comparacoes: Your storefront does not yet enter comparisons
layout.tambem_em_falta: Also missing, without blocking purchasing — they improve your score: {{lista}}.
layout.em_falta: Missing, without blocking purchasing — they improve your score: {{lista}}.

entrar.subtitulo: Manage your storefront and your prices.
entrar.identificador_ajuda: The code came in the registration email, in the format F followed by four digits.
entrar.utilizador_comprador: Are you a user of a buying company?

ajudaEstadoArtigo.RASCUNHO: Only you can see it. No buyer will find it.
ajudaEstadoArtigo.PUBLICADO: Visible and purchasable in every comparison.
ajudaEstadoArtigo.ESGOTADO: Still visible — buyers can see it exists and will come back. It stays in searches.
ajudaEstadoArtigo.DESCONTINUADO: Removed from comparisons. It stays in the history of past purchases.
